3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2** incident **INC-0001** titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary of the actions taken. On-call has been paged.

Recommendation: hold v2.3.1 from re-deployment until the root cause of the health check failures is investigated.
